newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serb Telekom, Stet seen signing deal.
newsitem.headline: Serb Telekom, Stet seen signing deal.

text.p: New Serbian telecommunications company Telekom Srbija and the Italian state telecommunications holding Stet are seen signing a 1.57 billion German marks privatisation deal on Friday, Beta news agency reported.
Serbia's government, being a 100-percent owner of the Telekom Srbija, agreed to most proposals by the Italian company, including the price, Beta said quoting sources close to the negotiations.
It said Serbia will receive one billion marks in cash immediately after signing the deal, while the remaining 570 million marks will be paid in two tranches by January 1, 1998.
There was no-one immediately available for comment in Telekom Srbije or Serbian privatisation ministry.
The Italian Embassy in Belgrade could not confirm the news.
A Stet spokesman in Rome said: "Yes, we are interested and, yes we are talking, but no deal has been reached."
